Rule the Game—And Your Future
Being a Maryville College Scot helps you form lifelong friendships and grow as part of a team. You’ll learn to work seamlessly with people from different backgrounds and perspectives and develop leadership skills that serve you in the game as well as in life.
Athletics has been a part of Maryville College since 1876, and today we have 17 NCAA Division III varsity teams. Sixteen of those teams compete in the Southern Athletic Association, and our newest sport, stunt, competes as an NCAA Independent. Our athletics culture is an excellent reflection of just how active our campus is: Over 40 percent of all students play on a varsity team (and the total reaches over half when counting intramurals or club sports).
Sport Schedules
Put on your school colors and come out to cheer on the MC Scots! Our athletics calendar is filled with sporting events throughout the year to keep you cheering. Learn More »
Student-Athletes
Over forty percent of our students are athletes who succeed in the classroom, as well as on the field or court. Overall, our teams have claimed 121 conference titles, have qualified for 85 NCAA tournaments, and produced 92 All-Americans. Learn More »
Clubs & Intramurals
More than half of Maryville’s students compete in a variety of club sports like a nationally competitive equestrian team, as well as intramural sports like softball, flag football, sand volleyball, and soccer. Learn More »
Outdoor Curriculum
The Smoky Mountains provide a beautiful backdrop for outdoor recreation, and the on-campus Mountain Challenge program organizes opportunities for you to get out in nature. Mountain Challenge also leads the unique Fit. Green. Happy. initiative.® Learn More »
